import csv,h5py
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
orig=defaultdict(set); info={}
with open('original_meta.csv',newline='') as f:
 for row in csv.DictReader(f):
  if row['Tissue']"'!='"'Tumor': continue
  orig[row['SampleID']].add(row['Cells'].split('_',1)[1])
  info[row['SampleID']]=(row['PatientID'],row['Disease'])
with h5py.File('lung.cancer.sc.h5ad','r') as f:
 idx=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in f['obs']['_index'][:]]
 codes=f['obs/sampleID/codes'][:]
 cats=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in f['obs/sampleID/categories'][:]]
 syn=defaultdict(set)
 for x,c in zip(idx,codes): syn[c].add(x.split('_',2)[2])
for c in range(len(cats)):
 scores=sorted(((len(syn[c]&v),k,len(v)) for k,v in orig.items()),reverse=True)
 top=scores[:3]
 print(cats[c],len(syn[c]),[(k,n,N,info[k],round(n/len(syn[c]),3)) for n,k,N in top])
